about: The fixed views every look step is judged on. Camera at eye, aimed at look, field of view fov, game clock in hours. Same shots, same order, every time. World coordinates as WorldBuilder builds them: lake water spans x -110..110 and z -80..80 at y 0, ground top is y 1, the dock runs from the south shore north at x 0 (z 80 to 34), the stands and home pond sit south of the dock (z 96 to 106). Cedar Creek runs north to south along x -230 (riffle z 30..75, deep pool z -70..-10), entered through the gate at x -158. (The first baseline on 11/26/2026 was shot while the whole Lake model sat 6 west, 10 up and 55 north of these; the shots were moved by the same amount on 11/26/2026 so they frame the same places.) Golden-hour shots are at 17.4 since 11/27/2026: in Roblox the sun sets at 18.0, so 18.4 showed dusk. Sets (11/27/2026, leg 3 N0): A is the home lake and the creek (group lake or creek), B the Big Lake (x -200..200, z -440..-140; the channel x -15..15 from z -78 to -142 with its footbridge at z -85; the island round (-90, -240) with the lighthouse at (-72, -239); the buoy line at z -290, blue water north of it), C the boats (N4) and D the island (N6). Set U is six UI screens (kind screen), each captured at every size in screen_sizes over the dock-end noon view; their luau runs after a shared prelude in shots.py and asks the Studio-only DebugScreen hook in the Controller first. Since 11/27/2026 (N2 review 1): the desktop size is the Studio viewport as it is, at least 1280 by 720, no Device Simulator, with its ViewportSize recorded in run.json; the phone size is the Device Simulator at 667 by 375, cut out of the letterbox to exactly 667 by 375 and shown at 2x (shots.py phonecrop). Every screen's luau ends by returning tag(), the viewport size and the weather, and snippet uicheck is run before each capture (see shots.py).

luau: if not viaHook("shop") or not ui.Shop.Visible then
ui.Shop.Visible = true -- fallback: rows as built, without a refresh from the player state
return "screen u02-shop set (fallback: shown without a refresh; the DebugScreen hook is missing)" .. tag()

return "screen u03-journal: no DebugScreen hook. Press J now (user_keyboard_input) so the journal opens filled in, then capture" .. tag()

shots.what: A Rare catch card (Largemouth Bass, personal best)
luau: if not viaHook("card") or not ui.CatchCard.Visible then
-- fallback: fill the card by hand the way UI.catchCard does for a Rare fish (no fish model in the window)
pcall(function() local U = require(Shared.Units); len, wt = U.length(46), U.weight(1.5) end)
card.Body.Text = string.format("Rare. %s, %s. Worth 38 coins.\nPersonal best!", len, wt)
card.Note.Text = "Caught at the weed bed on Plastic Worm."
if stroke then stroke.Color = col end
card:SetAttribute("Token", -1) -- so no pending auto-close matches
return "screen u04-card-rare set (fallback: filled by hand, no fish in the window; the DebugScreen hook is missing)" .. tag()

shots.what: A fight in progress (fish inside the zone, reeling)
luau: if not viaHook("fight") or not ui.Fight.Visible then
-- fallback: pose the fight bar, reel prompt and drag box by hand, as UI.showFight draws them
ui.ReelPrompt.Sub.Text = "Hold the mouse button to reel. Let go when it runs."
if b then b.Visible = false end -- side buttons hide in a fight (UI.setLocked)
f.Visible, ui.ReelPrompt.Visible, ui.DragBox.Visible = true, true, true
return "screen u05-fight set (fallback: posed by hand; the DebugScreen hook is missing)" .. tag()

shots.what: The bait bench, baiting a worm on a small hook
luau: -- fallback: open a bait bench straight from its module and step it each frame. If this context
-- gets its own copy of the module, that copy builds its own bench gui; either way it shows the bench.
if not ok then return "screen u06-bench: could not load BaitBench (" .. tostring(BB) .. ")" end
BB.open({ bait = "Worm", hook = "Small", firstTime = false, auto = false, onDone = function() end })
return "screen u06-bench set (fallback: module opened directly; it times out after 20 s, so capture now)" .. tag()
return "screen u06-bench set (the bench times out after 20 s: capture now)" .. tag()
